description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library and/or graveyard for Rite of Flame and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Rite of Flame by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Seething Song from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
